sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the ship-level applicability and conditional arrangement requirement. It preserves the required iceClass input, requires hasRudderProtectionArrangement for IA and IA Super, and uses a non-exclusive fallback for other ice-class values without inventing controlled alternatives or cardinality restrictions.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the restrictive third sh:or branch using sh:in for IB, IC, II, and III. The requirement makes the arrangement obligation conditional only for IA and IA Super; it does not establish an exhaustive applicability intersection or authorize rejecting other iceClassValue instances.
